objective: Review the newest commit on release/0.3.0/test/pi-t3-rpc-fixtures, which adds synthesized T3 RPC fixtures and a replaying contract test, for whether it would catch the regressions it claims to.
scope: Claims: the fixtures cover a T3 session start, select, confirm, input, editor, notify and setStatus with responses, and a specialist completion arriving after agent_settled that starts a new root turn; the test fails when a consumed event shape changes or a T3-ignored UI method (setWidget, setTitle, set_editor_text, custom) appears; a staleness check ties fixtures to the installed Pi version; docs/development.md documents re-recording.

Check whether any assertion is vacuous (for example a turn tracker that only tests itself), whether the source scan for UI calls is sound, and whether the fixtures are typed against the pinned Pi RPC types.
constraints: Read-only; you may run bun test in that worktree.

criteria.text: The review states which claims the test proves and which it does not, with path:line
Every blocking finding names the regression the test would miss
